# CANDIDATE: ATR_CONTRACTION_BOS_BREAK_LONG

**Filed:** 2026-08-24
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)
**Type:** new_trigger
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

When volatility contracts to a low ATR percentile (indicating compressed price range and low momentum exhaustion) and price then breaks structure with expanding volume, a short-term momentum move is likely. This edge exists because ATR contraction often precedes explosive moves, and a volume-confirmed structure break signals institutional participation in the new direction.

## Mechanism

Entry: When (1) 14-period ATR < 20th percentile of ATR over prior 50 periods, (2) price makes a new higher high with close above prior high (BOS), and (3) volume > 1.3× 20-period average volume → enter long at BOS bar close. Exit: Initial stop at prior swing low (low before BOS) or breakout bar low (whichever is lower). Target at 2× risk or chandelier exit trailing 2× ATR. Regime filters: VIX < 22, time after 10:00 EST, and intraday structure showing higher lows (uptrend confirmation).
